column1: Supplementary Table 3. Repetition versus consistency: wrong molecular weight relayed (relayed/parsed runs; 60 compounds, three samples, full record). R0, weight alone; R1, a verbatim repeat field scaled with the weight; R2, the repeat left correct; B, the heavy-atom count scaled with the weight. On uncorrupted records with the repeat field present, every model answered correctly in 60 of 60 runs. Pooled discordant pairs for RC1 (R0 relayed and R1 not, against the reverse): 198 against 84, two-sided McNemar p < 10^-10; for RC3 (R2 against R0), p < 10^-10.
